transcriptome: Zea mays B73 leaf drought-response transcriptome (synthetic example)

libraryProtocol.name: Illumina Stranded Total RNA Prep, Ligation with Ribo-Zero Plus

documentation: Reads aligned to Zm-B73-REFERENCE-NAM-5.0; models assembled with StringTie and written out from the genome with gffread. rRNA-depleted total RNA libraries; the models include protein-coding and long non-coding transcripts, so moleculeType is mixed. Because the final sequences were extracted from the genome, a real record links that genome as an FHR transcribedFrom parent with its checksum; none is given here because no FHR-headed genome file is cited. Synthetic example for the FHT development contract: names, statistics and sequence bytes are invented; taxon and ontology identifiers and kit names are real.
